create_emo_classification_dataset: create an Emo classification dataset instance with happy, sad, angry, and others emotion labels
load_emo_huggingface_dataset: load the emo HuggingFace dataset using datasets.load_dataset for emotion classification tasks
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace emo dataset split to a list of text and emotion label tuples
get_train_test_lines: get train and test line tuples from the emo dataset using map_hf_dataset_to_list
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot few-shot learning data splits with configurable seed and output path
